instruction: Candid documentary medium close-up of an indoor wedding venue with floral decorations. On the right, the older woman in a floral dress (R1), with her back partially turned, reaches up to place a gold necklace around the neck of the young bride in a red dress (R2) on the left. The young bride looks down slightly while holding her rose bouquet. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows and highlighting the rich red and floral tones.
